svg.title: Knitted toque, three-quarter facing right: a snug red crown, a darker ribbed red cuff and a white pom on top. The cuff runs level over the face and clears the highest brow in every expression and presentation (checked by the generator), then drops behind the ear. THE POM IS DRAWN LARGE ON PURPOSE: at play size the bobble is the one thing whose silhouette separates knitted headwear from a smooth shell, and at 20 x 20 it was too small to do it. It is now 28 x 22, grown sideways and down rather than up so it stays inside the part window and no rig geometry moves. Colour, crown, cuff and ink are untouched. WHY THIS IS NOT THE FIX IT WAS FIRST COMMITTED AS, recorded because the mistake is instructive. A blind run reported `player-on-a-bicycle` breaching that subject's `neverAdd: helmet`, and this part was enlarged on the assumption that the toque was what had been misread. IT WAS NOT IN THAT PICTURE. Every bicycle render the hand-off builds - gating and diagnostic, in two separate runs - carries `headCovering: none`, and so do the skateboard, toboggan, skates, guide and officer renders; the ONLY render in the whole hand-off wearing this part is `player`. What the blind run actually saw was the blond `bob` hair, which at 390 px is a smooth rounded cap with a defined lower edge. So there is no helmet in this project's art, nothing was removed, and this change improves the one subject that does wear a toque while doing nothing at all for the one that was reported.
